paragraphs.source_zh: 利家放在腿上的拳头握得咯吱作响。那只猴子木下藤吉郎虽多言善辩，却还带着体贴之意，爱智十阿弥口中则完全是伤人自尊的讽刺和挖苦。利家忍住怒气，笑道：“即使被杀死，也会心怀怨恨吧。那怨魂会投生到何处呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: Jūami was forever warning himself not to go too far, but by the time he realized what he was doing, his cutting mockery and sarcasm had already lashed the other man like a whip. In his heart, however, he deeply respected Toshiie and relied upon him just as deeply. Thus, though his manner was certainly insolent, it was also unquestionably an expression of intimacy.

units.source_en: Jūami was forever warning himself not to go too far, but by the time he realized what he was doing, his cutting mockery and sarcasm had already lashed the other man like a whip.

ja.t: ってしまっているのだった。

units.source_zh: 太过分就不好了，十阿弥时刻这样提醒自己，但当他明白过来时，尖刻的挖苦和讽刺已经如同鞭子一般抽到对方身上。

units.source_en: In his heart, however, he deeply respected Toshiie and relied upon him just as deeply.
units.source_zh: 在内心，他却对利家尊重十分，依赖十分。

units.source_en: Thus, though his manner was certainly insolent, it was also unquestionably an expression of intimacy.
units.source_zh: 因此这固然显得无礼，无疑也是亲密的表现。

paragraphs.source_zh: 太过分就不好了，十阿弥时刻这样提醒自己，但当他明白过来时，尖刻的挖苦和讽刺已经如同鞭子一般抽到对方身上。在内心，他却对利家尊重十分，依赖十分。因此这固然显得无礼，无疑也是亲密的表现。

paragraphs.source_en: Whenever bystanders saw Jūami mercilessly taunting the hard-pressed Toshiie, they could not help worrying in silence. Nobunaga knew perfectly well that Toshiie must resent him for it, and so he ordered Toshiie to “kill” Jūami.

units.source_en: Whenever bystanders saw Jūami mercilessly taunting the hard-pressed Toshiie, they could not help worrying in silence.
units.source_zh: 每当看到十阿弥尖刻地挖苦疲于应付的利家，旁人无不暗自担心。

units.source_en: Nobunaga knew perfectly well that Toshiie must resent him for it, and so he ordered Toshiie to “kill” Jūami.
units.source_zh: 信长深知利家对此一定怀恨在心，所以让他“杀”了十阿弥。

paragraphs.source_zh: 每当看到十阿弥尖刻地挖苦疲于应付的利家，旁人无不暗自担心。信长深知利家对此一定怀恨在心，所以让他“杀”了十阿弥。

paragraphs.source_en: And what of Toshiie, banished for having “killed” Jūami? He could hide in the household of Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami at Agui and repeat to Lady Odai, Motoyasu’s own mother, what Jūami had told the people of Okazaki. Then, through Odai, he could deliberately or casually convey the same information to Mizuno Nobumoto at Kariya Castle and to the retainers in Okazaki.

units.source_en: And what of Toshiie, banished for having “killed” Jūami?
units.source_zh: “杀死”十阿弥而被驱逐的利家呢？

units.source_en: He could hide in the household of Hisamatsu Sado-no-kami at Agui and repeat to Lady Odai, Motoyasu’s own mother, what Jūami had told the people of Okazaki.
units.source_zh: 他可以藏匿在阿古居久松佐渡守家中，将十阿弥向冈崎众人所说的话，向元康的亲生母亲於大夫人复述一遍。

units.source_en: Then, through Odai, he could deliberately or casually convey the same information to Mizuno Nobumoto at Kariya Castle and to the retainers in Okazaki.
units.source_zh: 并通过於大，有意无意向刈谷城的水野信元和冈崎的家臣们传递同样的信息。

paragraphs.source_zh: “杀死”十阿弥而被驱逐的利家呢？他可以藏匿在阿古居久松佐渡守家中，将十阿弥向冈崎众人所说的话，向元康的亲生母亲於大夫人复述一遍。并通过於大，有意无意向刈谷城的水野信元和冈崎的家臣们传递同样的信息。

paragraphs.source_en: Jūami grasped all this at once and told Toshiie not to go to Sunpu; but the honest Toshiie seemed to misunderstand Jūami’s meaning, taking it to mean that he should go and tell Motoyasu what Nobunaga intended. If he did that and the affair came to light, Yoshimoto would kill not only Toshiie but even Motoyasu.

units.source_en: Jūami grasped all this at once and told Toshiie not to go to Sunpu;
units.source_zh: 十阿弥对此迅速心领神会，告诉利家不要去骏府；

units.source_en: but the honest Toshiie seemed to misunderstand Jūami’s meaning, taking it to mean that he should go and tell Motoyasu what Nobunaga intended.
units.source_zh: 但老实的利家好像误解了十阿弥之意，他理解为，去将信长的意思告诉元康。

units.source_en: If he did that and the affair came to light, Yoshimoto would kill not only Toshiie but even Motoyasu.
units.source_zh: 若是那样，一旦事情败露，义元甚至连元康都会杀掉。

paragraphs.source_zh: 十阿弥对此迅速心领神会，告诉利家不要去骏府；但老实的利家好像误解了十阿弥之意，他理解为，去将信长的意思告诉元康。若是那样，一旦事情败露，义元甚至连元康都会杀掉。
